paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 3.3, representing a decrease of 2.89% from the prior close and 30.88% over the last 23 sessions. There have been 6 new news articles in the last 24 hours. Recent news includes an amendment to the terms of an equipment supply loan from MUFG Bank and a price target reduction from Cantor Fitzgerald.

The recent news headlines also include a US regulator supporting a license for four AP1000 reactors at Fermi America's Project Matador and major shareholder Toby Neugebauer selling shares of the stock. Additionally, there have been reports of other entities tied to a 10% owner selling Fermi shares.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 Form 4 and 2 Form 144 filings. Recent filings include an 8-K form announcing a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank and a Form 4 filing reporting an insider transaction.
